steps.content: Late at night, at the Cat's Eye Café.
You arrive to find the three sisters still in their catsuits. They have been waiting.

Kisugi Rui takes out the last piece of the Otherland Angels. The painting disintegrates, its substance dissolving into Mania energy that fades into the air. Only a fragment depicting an angel remains.
The other sisters produce their matching fragments, drawing them together.
The pieces of Otherland Angels clatter against each other. At the same time, the familiar yet strange power writhes within the three sisters—a desperate, screaming force trying to claw its way out.
A crimson glow spills from your palm, wrapping everyone in a warm embrace.
The three pieces of Otherland Angels settle. They drift toward one another until they blur and merge into a single, seamless masterpiece.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: Rui! It's... it's the complete painting! We actually did it!!!

steps.speaker: Kisugi Ai
steps.content: Yes!! Does this mean we can finally go home?!
A wave of pure joy crashes over the sisters, and they cling to each other in hope, their eyes searching for the promised rift that will lead them home.
However, a faint, tearing sound makes them, and you, tense.

The black and white center of the painting is parting, forming a rift. Yet from the narrow opening, a tide of dark, contaminated creatures emerges. They writhe and force their way through, desperate, as if this was the moment they had been poised for.
You step in front of the sisters, a human shield. Your shackles flare to life. Their power slams into the monsters, shoving the contaminated horde back through the rift.
